q: The Seifert-van Kampen theorem in HoTT (pushout of fundamental groups) computes π₁ of a pushout A ←f B →g C as:
opts: The pushout (amalgamated free product) of π₁(A) and π₁(C) over π₁(B) — the HoTT proof uses the recursion principle of the pushout HIT
exp: HoTT van Kampen: given a pushout of spaces (represented as HITs), π₁ of the pushout is the pushout (amalgamated free product) of the fundamental groups. The proof uses the universal property of the pushout HIT and the recursion principle for π₁ (loop induction).
